bigquery-utils.note: Default branch on 2026-10-28. The copyright holder is in the header of each selected file.

chinook-database.note: Default branch on 2026-10-28. The dialect comes from the database in the file name.

clickhouse.note: Tag v25.8.9.20-lts. Only the stateless tests 00000 to 00299. The full folder has 67 tests in the size range, 3.9 MB in total.

db-sample-schemas.note: Default branch on 2026-10-28. Not order_entry: 39 files (3.4 MB) in the size range, most of them product text in many languages. The selected files have the notice 'Copyright (c) 2023 Oracle'.

emerging-solutions-toolbox.note: Default branch on 2026-10-28. The copyright holder is in the header of selected files.

pagila.note: Default branch on 2026-10-28. The data files are more than 2 MiB.

copyright: The Regents of the University of California
postgres.note: Tag REL_17_6. The regression tests have psql commands.

sakila.note: Default branch on 2026-10-28. The data files are more than 2 MiB. README.md names the second copyright holder. The MySQL files are in the source sakila-mysql.

spark.note: Tag v4.2.1. The SQL test inputs of Spark SQL, but not the 2 postgreSQL folders: their files are ports of the PostgreSQL regression tests, with the notice 'Portions Copyright (c) 1996-2019, PostgreSQL Global Development Group'. The postgres source has the original tests.

sql-server-samples.note: Default branch on 2026-10-28. Not wide-world-importers: 33 files (6.8 MB) in the size range, most of them data. The northwind-pubs files have the notice 'Copyright Microsoft, Inc. 1994 - 2000'.
